GCLI-56: the guard (retry once, then exit 7 indeterminate) covers 6 of the 8 git reads in src/codemap.ts (rev-parse, cat-file -t, merge-base, diff --unified=0, grep -l, grep -n; keyed on exit 0 with empty stdout; name-only, numstat and the exit-1 cases are legitimate, including the quoted src/café.ts grep -n). The node measurement and its controls are in the GCLI-56 and GCLI-51 notes (0 of 1500 reads on the shipped bundle under 150 busy loops, 95% upper bound about 2e-3 per read; the fault itself was measured on bun only). opum-doc ruled arm A: the guard stays at codemap.ts and the src/git.ts audit is the post-tag follow-up GCLI-60 (label hold, not started).

Then the tag, which names a commit containing all of the above. No tag, publish, visibility flip, GitHub or npm setting or promotion without the operator's own dialog.

HELD, DO NOT START: S1-S5 until the leader says; GCLI-60. CI capacity: the operator capped CI at 4 concurrent jobs (runner pool 10 -> 4); expect short queues; one push at a time; stagger landings; one re-run per red PR; no raised timeouts to mask load; a conflicted PR gets no CI.

PROCESS FACTS LEARNED: the Ownership guard refuses commands that touch other worktrees (review-*, measure-*, agent-*), use shell variables in write targets outside the roots, or build targets in the shell; use literal scratchpad paths and the Write tool. The guard-composed-push hook refuses git push joined to another command: run git push alone; the trunk guard refuses 'git commit' text anywhere in a composed command while on dev, so branch first. Foreground sleep is blocked: use an until-loop. An npx download of an unpinned tool was refused by the permission layer and not retried. Implementer specialists run with isolation worktree (they may start from an older base: check HEAD); I push and open PRs, they never do; review worktrees review-* are the leader's (DEC-208) and stay registered. Quest tracker-only PRs may land on green with --match-head-commit. If a tracker PR goes CONFLICTING on the same task record, merge dev and re-apply the notes with quest, never hand-edit .quest JSON. Task ids: GCLI-55 Check fix, GCLI-56 (a5), GCLI-58 parity fix, GCLI-60 follow-up, GCLI-57 and GCLI-59 are reserved for the tasks above. The measurement tooling (git wrapper on PATH logging reads, node harness, load script, pre-fix bundle) lived in the session scratchpad and is described in the GCLI-56 notes; it may be gone.
